title: AI Product Manager LLM, Real-Time AI Solutions
jd_excerpt: A leading technology company in Dunwoody is seeking a Mid-Senior level Product Manager to drive AI/ML initiatives. The role involves leading the development of innovative AI-powered products from strategy to launch. Candidates should have a robust background in product management, experience with AI technologies, and strong communication skills to translate technical risks into business insights. This full-time position offers a dynamic work environment focused on AI advancements.
